result.raw_final:
Qatar Airways’ Economy baggage allowance depends on route and fare:

- **Carry-on:** 1 piece up to **7 kg (15 lb)**. Flights to/from Brazil allow up to **10 kg (22 lb)**.
- **Checked, flights to/from Africa or the Americas:** Economy Lite allows **1 bag up to 23 kg (50 lb)**; Classic, Convenience and Comfort allow **2 bags up to 23 kg each**.
- **Checked, other destinations:** Lite **20 kg**, Classic **25 kg**, Convenience **30 kg**, Comfort **35 kg**.

Check your ticket for the exact allowance, as route and fare rules apply. <citation refs="wZiIEKS_yt7wEaFTFMbvS">$20–35 kg checked allowances and 7 kg carry-on</citation>
